preset_browser.function: Preset selection plus category/text filtering. Filtering is non-destructive and must not load another preset.

mode_selector.function: MELODY/PATTERN selection; PUNK GROUP is reserved and not yet exposed as a working mode.

midi_keyboard.function: On-screen MIDI keyboard; note events are sent to the instrument.

LCD_display.function: Current status, preset and library feedback. A dedicated hardware-style LCD treatment is a visual goal.
LCD_display.visualStatus: statusLabel only; no dedicated LCD widget

LED_indicator.function: Reserved activity/status indicator. No live MIDI/audio meter is currently wired; never fabricate activity.
LED_indicator.visualStatus: not implemented; must not simulate activity

SKIN_button.function: Opens visual theme selection; Ctrl+K shortcut.

Import_Guitar.function: Opens SFZ selection and requests asynchronous guitar library loading.
Import_Guitar.actionBinding: loadButton -> chooseSfzFile -> asynchronous processor SFZ load

Auto_Discover.function: Reserved for production Sound Hunter/S6 discovery. Must remain unavailable until integrated.
Auto_Discover.availability: not implemented; disabled/unavailable until real feature integration

Curator.function: Reserved for Sound Hunter curator/library review. Must remain unavailable until integrated.
Curator.availability: not implemented; disabled/unavailable until real feature integration

Settings.function: Reserved settings panel; do not expose an active non-functional action.
Settings.availability: not implemented; disabled/unavailable until real feature integration

About.function: Reserved About panel; enable only when it reports actual product/build metadata.
About.availability: not implemented; disabled/unavailable until real feature integration

sync_selector.function: Host / Host Start / Internal transport synchronization.

preset_search.function: Catalog search without loading a different preset.

library_load_status.function: SFZ load progress/result and missing-library feedback.

rules.missingRuntimeControls: Keep IDs in parity contract; never claim unavailable functionality. A disabled placeholder is acceptable only with an honest reason and cannot simulate activity.
rules.layoutOwnership: Coordinates are design metadata until a layout engine consumes them. Existing JUCE bounds and hit targets remain authoritative.

inventorySource.note: UI control ranges are copied from APVTS parameter declarations; reserved controls are explicitly marked unavailable and are not represented as implemented.
